title: Remediate WebView Tab UX
summary: Improve WebView tab and navigation semantics for operator workflow clarity.
reason: The NN/g tab review found mixed page navigation and in-page tabs, excessive Settings tab wrapping, and hidden readiness evidence near high-risk operator actions.
behavior_before: Pending Publish was presented inside the Completed Output tab strip as a page jump, Completed tab state used aria-pressed instead of ARIA tab semantics, Settings exposed nine operator sections as true tabs, Library profiles were rendered as tabs, and launch/diagnostics readiness evidence was partly buried behind nondefault tabs.
behavior_after: Pending Publish is a first-class sidebar page, Completed Output uses a true Overview/History/Evidence tablist, Settings and Library profile selectors use navigation semantics with aria-current, Start Decision Summary appears on the default Launch workflow, and backend lifecycle evidence appears on Diagnostics Overview.
manual_validation: bundled python unittest Pending Publish browser smoke - passed
bundled python unittest focused static WebView tests - passed (81 tests)
bundled/system python pytest unavailable; unittest fallback used
node --check changed WebView JS files - passed
settings/launch and layout-manager broader browser smokes failed on pre-existing non-tab selector/label contracts
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView tab/navigation markup, lifecycle selector wiring, CSS navigation styles, diagnostics tail document guard, focused WebView test updates, refreshed summaries, and this change packet.
notes:
WebView-only presentation and accessibility remediation; backend media policy, queue mutation, pending-publish drain, settings persistence, rename apply, filesystem mutation, and close-readiness authority remain backend-owned.
Implemented WebView tab UX remediation; targeted JS syntax, focused unittest static suite, and pending publish browser smoke passed. Broader browser smoke residuals are documented in manual validation.
